sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – binding full-volume proposal from 2027-01-01
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. To secure supply from 2027-01-01, we propose a binding package: EUR 29.89/unit for 23,400 pcs/year, committed in full if agreed, over 24 months with a 56-day lead time. Payment 30 days, DAP, no index clause and no tooling remain unchanged.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); we do not assert that this is your actual cost or margin.

This is a firm two-year commitment of our full need, in line with your stated priority for firm, long-term commitments. If approval beyond your level is needed, would you be willing to sponsor this package internally?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – binding full-volume proposal from 2027-01-01
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your theoretical cost estimate does not reflect our specialized manufacturing processes and cannot serve as a basis for this negotiation. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. Which volume can you commit to?

We acknowledge your proposal for a 24-month contract at 23,400 units per year. In recognition of the increased volume and extended term, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.70 per unit. Specifically, our proposal stands at a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm (part:340010) – revised binding package from 2027-01-01
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for confirming that you checked the cost data we cited. To answer your question: we can commit to our full need of 23,400 pcs per year, binding over 24 months.

We are moving our price and propose this binding package: EUR 30.10/unit, 23,400 pcs/year, 24 months, 56-day lead time. Payment 30 days, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling remain unchanged.

Supplier-wide on-time delivery was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3); we ask for commercial recognition of this service record in the package.

Does this price movement help close the gap between our positions?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm (part:340010) – revised binding package from 2027-01-01
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your revised proposal and the delivery data provided. The cited delivery record does not justify a commercial adjustment to our pricing. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

In response to your price movement, we adjust our offer to EUR 31.60 per unit for the 24-month commitment at 23,400 units per year. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: New 36-month commitment for seal part 340010
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for stating your 24-month position clearly. Would a new 36-month commitment allow a different commercial approval?

We can now offer EUR 30.96/unit for a binding 23,400 pcs/year over 36 months, with a 56-day lead time. This raises our proposed price and adds a third committed year, in line with your priority for firm, long-term commitments. Payment 30 days, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling remain unchanged.

Could you approve this complete package?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: New 36-month commitment for seal part 340010
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We are withdrawing from this negotiation. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

Our Angebot remains valid for 14 days under our standard conditions and procedure.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.
